dmm-2012-tiebreaker-01.prompt: An $8$-inch by $11$-inch sheet of paper is laid flat so that the top and bottom edges are $8$ inches long. The paper is then folded so that the top left corner touches the right edge. What is the minimum possible length of the fold?

dmm-2012-tiebreaker-02.prompt: Triangle $ABC$ is equilateral, with $AB=6$. There are points $D,E$ on segment $AB$ (in the order $A,D,E,B$), points $F,G$ on segment $BC$ (in the order $B,F,G,C$), and points $H,I$ on segment $CA$ (in the order $C,H,I,A$) such that $DE=FG=HI=2$. Considering all such configurations of $D,E,F,G,H,I$, let $A_1$ be the maximum possible area of the (possibly degenerate) hexagon $DEFGHI$ and let $A_2$ be the minimum possible area. Find $A_1-A_2$.
